Bots post only what the group must act on to the chat. Progress stays in Work.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.15.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **Only what the group must act on.** A bot posts to its group only a blocker, a decision, or a question someone must answer now. It no longer posts progress such as "checking now" or "calling a tool". Progress goes to the group's **Work** section.
- **Mid-turn posts still work.** A bot can post that kind of step to its own group while it takes a turn there (since 1.8.14).

## Older versions

Install 1.8.15 on every computer that opens a group. An older app still posts progress into the chat.
